title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of an electrifying show highlighted by a stellar Lovelight and one of the best Spanish Jams ever
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this partial soundboard recording, calling it crystal‑clear and giving it full marks for audio quality. The performance is described as one of the finest Lovelights heard and features an unforgettable, fierce Spanish Jam with Gregg Allman trading vocals, making the show a must‑listen.

ai_rating.rationale: All five enthusiastic reviews award 5 stars and praise both the music and the soundboard source; only one outlier gives a 0‑star rating, so the weighted average is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture; no reported muddiness, dropouts or balance issues – reviewers call the source "awesome" and give it full marks.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with high energy, featuring Pigpen and Gregg Allman swapping vocals on Lovelight and a ferocious Spanish Jam that many reviewers call the best they've heard. The overall vibe is described as two (or three) bands merging into one unforgettable performance.
